stages.beat_note: Layla has arrived at the mining village on Floor 4, but hasn't yet learned how to pass beyond the sealed fortress gate or descend to Floor 5.

stages.summary: Recover the Teleportation Scroll from Commander Malik's safe.
stages.beat_note: Layla learned that the military fortress gate is locked, but Commander Malik holds an ancient Teleportation Scroll in his safe. She needs to infiltrate the fortress and retrieve it.
stages.update_message: Find Commander Malik's safe inside the military fortress and retrieve the Teleportation Scroll.

stages.summary: Activate the teleport platform to descend to Floor 5.
stages.beat_note: Having acquired the knowledge of the Teleportation Sigil, Layla can now reach the teleport platform in the heart of the fortress and descend.
stages.update_message: Use the Teleportation Sigil at the teleport platform to descend to Floor 5.

stages.beat_note: Layla hasn't yet heard the dark truth about the village council surrendering the orphan boy Zayd as a sacrifice to the garrison.

stages.summary: Rescue the orphan boy Zayd from the military complex.
stages.beat_note: Elder Rashid and Yasmin revealed that the village council offered Zayd as a tithe sacrifice. Layla needs to find the boy and rescue him from his iron cage.
stages.update_message: Search the military complex for the orphan boy Zayd and rescue him from the garrison.

stages.summary: Escort Zayd back to safety in the village.
stages.beat_note: Zayd is rescued from his cage. Escort him back to the safety of the worker village.
stages.update_message: Escort Zayd back to the village safely.
